sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

content.text: Juggling anteater on a unicycle — building your animated SVG.

arguments.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">
<title>Anteater riding unicycle while juggling bottles</title>
<style>
  .bg { fill: #E8F6FF; }
  .ground { fill: #9ED99E; }
  .road { fill: #888; }
  .fur { fill: #A67C52; }
  .fur-dark { fill: #7A5636; }
  .snout-light { fill: #D9C6A5; }
  .stripe { fill: #2B2B2B; }
  .wheel-tire { fill: none; stroke: #222; stroke-width: 10; }
  .spoke { stroke: #555; stroke-width: 3; }
  .frame { stroke: #E63946; stroke-width: 6; stroke-linecap: round; }
  .bottle-glass { fill: #4CC9F0; stroke: #0A5C76; stroke-width: 2; }
  .bottle-cap { fill: #F72585; }
</style>

<!-- background -->
<rect class="bg" width="800" height="600" rx="12"/>
<circle cx="680" cy="90" r="45" fill="#FFD93D"/>
<ellipse cx="150" cy="100" rx="70" ry="22" fill="white" opacity="0.9"/>
<ellipse cx="195" cy="90" rx="50" ry="20" fill="white" opacity="0.9"/>
<rect class="ground" y="490" width="800" height="110"/>
<rect class="road" y="490" width="800" height="18"/>
<!-- moving dashes to show forward motion -->
<g fill="#fff">
  <rect x="0" y="493" width="60" height="6" rx="3">
    <animate attributeName="x" values="800;-80" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>
  <rect x="200" y="493" width="60" height="6" rx="3">
    <animate attributeName="x" values="800;-80" dur="1.2s" begin="-0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>
  <rect x="400" y="493" width="60" height="6" rx="3">
    <animate attributeName="x" values="800;-80" dur="1.2s" begin="-0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>
</g>

<!-- whole rider bobbing -->
<g>
  <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -8; 0 0" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

  <!-- UNICYCLE -->
  <!-- wheel -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="430" r="62" class="wheel-tire"/>
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 400 430" to="-360 400 430" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g class="spoke">
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="400" y2="374"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="448" y2="402"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="448" y2="458"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="400" y2="486"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="352" y2="458"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="352" y2="402"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="400" cy="430" r="8" fill="#E63946" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- cranks/pedals rotating with wheel -->
    <g stroke="#222" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="430" y2="412"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="370" y2="448"/>
    </g>
    <rect x="420" y="405" width="22" height="8" rx="2" fill="#222"/>
    <rect x="348" y="447" width="22" height="8" rx="2" fill="#222"/>
  </g>
  <!-- frame + seat -->
  <line class="frame" x1="400" y1="430" x2="400" y2="315"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="308" rx="42" ry="12" fill="#222"/>

  <!-- ANTEATER -->
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M 340 290 Q 230 250 210 150 Q 260 180 300 230 Q 330 260 360 270 Z" fill="#7A5636">
    <animate attributeName="d" values="M 340 290 Q 230 250 210 150 Q 260 180 300 230 Q 330 260 360 270 Z;
    M 340 290 Q 230 260 205 170 Q 255 195 295 240 Q 330 265 360 270 Z;
    M 340 290 Q 230 250 210 150 Q 260 180 300 230 Q 330 260 360 270 Z" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </path>

  <!-- back leg -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-12 380 300; 22 380 300; -12 380 300" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <path d="M 380 300 L 365 380 L 375 448" fill="none" stroke="#7A5636" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="410" cy="270" rx="75" ry="48" class="fur"/>
  <!-- classic anteater shoulder stripe -->
  <path d="M 380 230 L 430 235 L 365 310 L 335 295 Z" class="stripe" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M 385 232 L 425 236 L 370 305 L 350 295 Z" fill="white" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- front leg pedaling (other phase) -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="22 430 300; -12 430 300; 22 430 300" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <path d="M 430 300 L 435 380 L 425 412" fill="none" stroke="#A67C52" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- long snout head pointing forward (right) -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 470 255; -4 470 255; 0 470 255" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <path d="M 460 240 Q 560 235 590 255 Q 592 265 580 268 Q 520 270 465 285 Z" class="fur"/>
    <path d="M 540 242 Q 570 248 585 256 L 545 262 Z" class="snout-light"/>
    <circle cx="583" cy="261" r="4" fill="#222"/>
    <circle cx="480" cy="248" r="7" fill="#222"/>
    <circle cx="482" cy="246" r="2" fill="white"/>
    <ellipse cx="465" cy="223" rx="10" ry="14" class="fur-dark"/>
  </g>

  <!-- juggling arms up -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-8 420 260; 10 420 260; -8 420 260" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <path d="M 420 260 Q 450 180 500 160" fill="none" stroke="#A67C52" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="503" cy="158" r="10" fill="#7A5636"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="10 400 260; -10 400 260; 10 400 260" dur="0.8s" begin="-0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <path d="M 400 260 Q 360 190 320 170" fill="none" stroke="#8A6543" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="317" cy="168" r="10" fill="#5E4028"/>
  </g>
</g>

<!-- JUGGLING BOTTLES - 3 bottles on looping arcs -->
<g id="bottles">
  <!-- bottle shape def as groups animated -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="320 160; 410 30; 500 160; 410 130; 320 160" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 0 0; 360 0 0" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g transform="translate(-12,-28)">
        <rect class="bottle-glass" x="0" y="10" width="24" height="36" rx="6"/>
        <rect x="7" y="0" width="10" height="12" fill="#0A5C76"/>
        <rect class="bottle-cap" x="5" y="-6" width="14" height="7" rx="2"/>
        <rect x="4" y="22" width="16" height="8" fill="white" opacity="0.5" rx="2"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="500 160; 410 130; 320 160; 410 30; 500 160" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 0 0; -360 0 0" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g transform="translate(-12,-28)">

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.
